subject: PO conditionality & quarterly prepaid-stub — invoice cadence proposal
messages:
From: Eli Torres <eli.torres@auratek.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements + invoicing cadence question

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement has reviewed the commercial summary and we need to confirm a couple of operational items before we can issue a PO:

- Auratek requires a single PO per fiscal quarter (we’ll provide a PO that covers the quarter) rather than monthly invoices.
- Net terms: our standard is Net 60 for vendor invoices, but we can do Net 30 for approved vendors. Any chance Redwood can accept Net 60?
- We also need the invoice to reference a single PO number and a project code (Auratek-OPS-22).

A potential wrinkle: Finance wants a small prepaid stub to cover onboarding costs for the first month — they asked whether that can be invoiced up front and then the remainder billed at quarter-end. Would Redwood be able to split the first-quarter invoice into a small prepay (one month) and the rest at quarter close, all tied to the same PO?

If this is possible we can expedite the PO. Attached is our PO template for reference.

Cheers,
Eli
Eli Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager, Auratek Systems

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Eli Torres <eli.torres@auratek.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoicing cadence question

Hi Eli —

Appreciate the clarity and the template. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate a quarterly PO with a one-month prepaid onboarding stub, but there are a few operational details to confirm so billing and revenue recognition align on both sides. Proposed approach below:

1) Prepaid stub: Redwood will issue an invoice for the onboarding stub (one month) immediately after PO receipt. That invoice will be due Net 30 (standard for invoice processing). If Auratek needs Net 60 on that stub specifically, we can escalate to finance for approval.

2) Quarterly invoice: The remainder of the quarter will be invoiced as a single statement at quarter close, referencing the same PO number and project code (Auratek-OPS-22). Our billing system will attach the PO and project code to both invoices.

3) Discount / packaging: We can offer a 7% volume discount on the quarterly bill if Auratek commits to a 12-month rolling minimum usage (we would include language in the SOW). Alternatively, without a 12-month commit we can extend a 3% credit applied at quarter close. Which structure does procurement prefer?

4) Required PO fields: please ensure PO includes: PO number, ship-to (Auratek billing address), payment entity (Auratek US), project code, and a contact for remittance. Vanessa (cc’d) will validate exact field mapping for our ERP.

If that sounds OK I can loop in Vivek from finance to confirm Net term flexibility and finalize the invoice schedule. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Vanessa / Vivek —

Looping you both in for operational confirmation. Auratek (external) wants: quarterly PO (single PO per quarter), one-month prepaid onboarding stub up front, and Net 60 preference. We can propose Net 30 on the stub and Net 60 on quarterly invoice if we need to match their procurement policy, but need finance to agree to Net 60 on the larger quarterly statement and confirm revenue recognition behavior.

Also: Pricing/discount ask — I proposed two options to keep procurement moving:
- 12-month rolling commit => 7% discount applied to quarterly invoice (requires SOW term)
- No commit => 3% credit applied after quarter close (accounting-friendly but less favorable for Redwood)

Vanessa — can you confirm we can map Auratek-OPS-22 to the PO field and include both invoice lines under the same PO? Any ERP limitations on multi-invoice per PO?

Vivek — can finance approve Net 60 on the quarterly invoice for this account if we receive a signed PO and PO-backed contract? If not, what guardrails would you need (e.g., credit check, prepay thresholds)?

Quick responses appreciated — procurement is ready to issue a PO once we confirm.

Thanks —
Grace

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. Finance has reviewed and we can support the proposed flow with these constraints:

1) Prepaid stub invoice: we will accept Net 60 on the onboarding stub only if Auratek provides a PO that explicitly states Net 60 terms for the stub line. Otherwise the stub will default to Net 30.

2) Quarterly invoice (remainder): we can accept Net 60 on the quarterly statement if the customer provides an approved PO and completes a one-time supplier credit form (attached in our vendor intake). For larger quarterly amounts (> $150k) we will require either a 30% prepayment or a signed credit addendum.

3) Discount application: the 7% discount requires an explicit 12-month SOW and minimum billing guarantee in the SOW. If procurement prefers the 3% post-quarter credit, that can be automated and does not require additional legal terms.

4) PO mapping: Vanessa, please confirm ERP field names for PO number, project code, and remittance so our billing team can map incoming invoices automatically.

Eli — if the above is acceptable, we can proceed. I’ll have procurement intake send the vendor credit form and an invoice instruction PDF to Eli after Grace confirms.

-Vivek
